prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Miami for hurricane-rated roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a reliable single “best” without comparing bids, but **Perkins Roofing** looks like a strong Miami candidate to put on your shortlist: it reports serving Miami-Dade since 1980 and handling tile, metal, shingle, and flat-roof replacements. Its site lists Florida roofing license **CCC1331944**. [Perkins Roofing](https://perkinsroofing.net/)

I’d also get a quote from **Art’s Roofing & Construction**, which lists Florida roofing license **CCC1333598** and says it pulls permits in Miami-Dade. [Art’s Roofing](https://www.artsroofing.com/)

Before choosing, verify the license is active with Florida DBPR, check recent local references, and compare written bids. For a Miami-Dade replacement, ask each contractor to specify the permitted roof assembly and Miami-Dade-approved products, wind-uplift details, underlayment, permit and inspection plan, and warranty. Don’t rely on a “hurricane-rated” or “Category 5” claim alone—the complete installed system and code-compliant workmanship matter.
